description: Measure a store page with Google PageSpeed Insights: Lighthouse score and lab metrics, real-visitor Core Web Vitals, the largest improvement opportunities and a diagnosis of the cause (LCP element and phases, request chain, render-blocking requests, third parties, layout-shift culprits). Each device takes 10–30 seconds; results are cached for an hour. On a password-protected store, only real-visitor data is available.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

page.description: A store URL or path, e.g. / or /products/blue-runner.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: check_page_speed
title: Check page speed
